web.title: On the web
web.body: From the browser on your phone or computer. Nothing to install.

mobile.title: Android & iOS app
mobile.body: With a widget to log an expense without opening the app.

ai.title: With your AI
ai.body: “Lukas, how much have I spent on restaurants?” and your assistant answers with your numbers.

log.title: Log it in seconds
log.body: Tap ＋, type the amount and you're done: under five seconds from opening the app. Lukas celebrates with you.

spend.title: See where it goes
spend.body: Every expense lands in its category. At a glance you know how much went on groceries, going out or getting around, and what living really costs you.

budgets.title: Budgets that give you a heads-up
budgets.body: Set a limit for each category. The bars fill up with what you spend and change color before you go over, not after.

import.title: Bring your history
import.body: Import your transactions from other finance apps: Budge today, Buddy and others soon.
import.demo_rows: {count, plural, one {# transaction ready} other {# transactions ready}}

open_source.title: Open source
open_source.body: Anyone can read Lukas's code: nothing in it is hidden. It's free software, licensed under the AGPL-3.0.

what.a: An app for your monthly budget that doesn't feel like homework. You log what you spend, see what's left in each category, and Lukas, a gold coin with plenty of personality, keeps you company: it cheers when you log something and gives you a heads-up when a category is filling up.

import.q: Can I bring my history from other apps?
import.a: Yes. Today you can import from Budge: export your transactions as a CSV and upload it when you sign up or later from Settings. Buddy and other apps are coming soon. Before anything is imported you see a preview: how many transactions come in, which ones are duplicates and which categories will be created.

passwords.q: Why doesn't it ask for a password?
passwords.a: Because you don't need one. You sign in with a 6-digit code or a link sent to your email and, if you like, with a passkey: your fingerprint, your face or your phone's screen lock. No password to remember.

privacy.q: What do you do with my data?
privacy.a: Your data travels encrypted, and we never sell it or share it with advertisers. You can export it or delete your account whenever you want. And since the code is open source, anyone can check what we do with it.

free.a: Yes, and it always will be. Lukas is free and open source: all the code is on <github>GitHub</github> for anyone to read. We never ask for a card.

languages.a: Spanish and English. Switch whenever you like in Settings, and amounts and dates follow your language's format.

closing.title: Ready when you are.
closing.body: Create your account with your email in under a minute. Lukas takes care of making it fun.
